predict.question: B has sixty minutes; each complete cycle is ten work plus ten startup minutes. How many work minutes does B complete?

exploreHint: Run both cases; compare the changed input.
bookIdea: Peopleware treats interruptions and the working environment as relevant to software work.
modelBoundary: A yields {A} work minutes; B {B}. Shorter chunks repeat the same ten-minute startup more often, leaving a larger share of the hour outside work. The startup cost is invented and constant, not a measured cognitive recovery time.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Real-world applicability and the connection to the book remain unverified.
